svg.text: When benefit need not be proven, the claim is the product
US dietary supplement products on the market, before and after the 1994 framework.
Twenty-five times the products, under a rule that never required anyone to show one works.
A hundred thousand products still have to be told apart. Evidence is optional and mostly absent, so it cannot do the sorting.
What is left to compete on is the claim. The noise is the regulation working as written.
Both figures are real and cited in the essay. Bar length encodes count; no area or radius scaling is used.
insights.freshfoodrecs.com · 1994 baseline and current FDA estimate · August 2026
